bio: With over a decade of experience in international trade and education consulting, Armand founded Nadoumi Consulting to bridge global opportunities and empower people to thrive beyond borders. His vision drives the company’s commitment to excellence, integrity, and customer success.
Amelia oversees global student advisory operations, guiding international applicants through university placements, scholarships, and visa support across China’s top institutions.

Dr Xiao Wei leads the trade consulting division, specializing in supplier verification, quality control, and export compliance. He ensures clients receive reliable sourcing and frictionless logistics.
